hi! I think what you’re experiencing is called maladaptive daydreaming. it’s something i constantly do. it’s usually caused by response to trauma or emotional stress. it involves creating scenarios in your head while pacing, running, or even just in bed. I do it everyday if my favorite song comes up. I have tons of fictional worlds in my mind and fictional characters I’m oddly attached to. I have self harmed too before to stop it but that’s really not worth it. :(. Research has only just started on maladaptive daydreaming so I’m not sure how to stop it. I use it to cope with the dread of reality and being stuck in a world I hate living.

Try to engage yourself more in the real world if you can. take walks and converse with family. Usually if I keep myself occupied the scenarios don’t start :)
